instruction.text: Mary has drawn the outline of her pie chart. Select the correct pieces to colour.

atoms.a: Select the piece that represents the people who said blue was their favourite colour.

instruction.text: Answer these questions about the pie chart.

atoms.a: What colour is the most popular?
Did a majority of people have purple as their favourite colour?
What is the least popular colour that is represented on this pie chart?
